action_summary: A PLACEHOLDER IS NOT A STATEMENT. Advanced census request 38 -- "Extract the loop in the function total in <pkg>/util.py into a helper" -- was refused REGION_INVALID on a region the repository proves. Two defects, no new primitive. (1) goal_front_compiler_v1.derive_declared_inputs wrote the literal 0 into start_line/end_line BEFORE asking declared_input_derivation_v1, so the proof was discarded before the adapter saw it; the proof is now asked first and 0 is written only when the sentence states no region. (2) The derivation read the host only from "in <name>" and answered "the", and the self-contained-block search widened a stated loop to its neighbours (2-4), which the adapter refuses; it now reads the role phrase ("the function total") and, when the sentence names the region kind, takes the single statement of that kind. Measured: #38 PASS in 48 ms with the loop really extracted, advanced census 2/49 -> 3/49, matrix unchanged at 22 REAL / 0 FALSE / 0 DAMAGED.

obs_goal.real_outcome: A request to profile, optimise, thread or fuzz is refused by name when no row declares that effect, instead of being answered by a function counter that passes.
obs_goal.surviving_necessity: A wrong answer costs more than a refusal: it spends the caller's trust on top of the request.

recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: The adapter already performs this extraction correctly -- called with qualname=total and lines 3-4 it returns gate PASS and one edit -- so the refusal was never a missing capability. The derivation module already had a block that computes a span from a host function's statements; it was unreachable because the binder wrote a 0 first and because the host phrase pattern only knew 'in <name>'. Two rules reuse both, no new module, and the alternative -- teaching the adapter to guess a region -- would have made the door invent what the sentence did not say.

weakens_existing_guard: No guard is weakened. The derivation still proves nothing it cannot read off the stated file's AST, and when the sentence states no region the placeholder is written exactly as before, so the adapter's REGION_INVALID refusal stands for every request that genuinely states no region. One new test pins that non-invention; another removes the role phrase and shows the proof disappears.
